hints.routing: A 9-digit number in the lower left corner of the check.
hints.account: A 3-17 digit number at the bottom of the check or on a bank statement.

messages.accountTypeRequired: The Account Type field is required.
messages.accountInvalid: Account Number must be numeric digits between 1 and 17

info: It's important to verify your entries to ensure payment is received to your valid bank account.

unable.title: Unable to verify bank account
unable.text: We couldn't identify an account using the details you entered. Make sure all details match your bank's records and that your account is active.

finalAttempt: Final attempt, review your details carefully.

help.title: You will find routing and account number:
items: on the bottom of the check as issued by your bank (routing number is located on the bottom-left corner and account number is located just to the right of your routing number);
on your banking application or your bank website.
